fn main() {
    let (sender, receiver) = flume::bounded(2);
    sender.send(11u32).unwrap();
    sender.send(29).unwrap();
    assert!(sender.try_send(31).is_err());
    let selected = flume::Selector::new().recv(&receiver, |value| value.unwrap()).wait();
    assert_eq!(selected, 11);
    assert_eq!(receiver.recv().unwrap(), 29);
    let second = sender.clone();
    let thread = std::thread::spawn(move || { second.send(37).unwrap(); });
    assert_eq!(receiver.recv().unwrap(), 37);
    thread.join().unwrap();
    drop(sender);
    assert!(receiver.recv().is_err());
    println!("{} {}", selected, receiver.len());
}
